evals.prompt: I need to create a fungible token with 8 decimals called 'GameGold' with symbol 'GG', mint 1 million initial supply to my operator account, then transfer 500 tokens to another account. Write the full JS script using @hiero-ledger/sdk.
evals.expected_output: A complete, runnable Node.js script that creates a fungible token, handles account creation/association, and transfers tokens using the Hiero SDK.

checks.name: creates-fungible-token
checks.description: Uses TokenCreateTransaction to create the token

checks.name: sets-decimals-8
checks.rubric: The output sets token decimals to 8 (for example via setDecimals(8) or an equivalent variable)

checks.name: handles-association
checks.rubric: The output handles token association for the recipient before transfer (for example TokenAssociateTransaction, setMaxAutomaticTokenAssociations for auto-association, or explaining why association is needed)

checks.name: uses-transfer-transaction
checks.description: Uses TransferTransaction for the token transfer

checks.name: signed-amounts-correct
checks.description: Uses negative amount for sender in token transfer
checks.rubric: The output uses a negative token amount for the sender in addTokenTransfer

evals.prompt: Write a script that creates an NFT collection with a 5% royalty fee, mints 3 NFTs with IPFS metadata URIs, and then transfers one of them to another account. Use the Hiero SDK.
evals.expected_output: A complete script demonstrating NFT creation with royalty fees, minting with metadata, and NFT transfer.

checks.name: mints-with-metadata
checks.rubric: The output mints NFTs with metadata (for example addMetadata, setMetadata, or passing metadata bytes to the mint call)

checks.name: sets-supply-key
checks.rubric: The output sets a supply key via setSupplyKey (required for minting)

checks.name: correct-royalty-fraction
checks.rubric: The output configures a 5% royalty fee (for example numerator 5 / denominator 100, or numerator 1 / denominator 20, or any equivalent fraction)

evals.prompt: I want to airdrop a fungible token to 3 accounts — one has unlimited auto-association, one has 1 slot, and one has 0. Show me how to handle the pending airdrops (claim and cancel). JavaScript please.
evals.expected_output: A script showing the full airdrop lifecycle including pending airdrop handling with claim and cancel.

checks.name: creates-varied-accounts
checks.description: Creates accounts with different auto-association settings

checks.name: accesses-pending-airdrops
checks.description: Accesses pending airdrops from the record
